TEXT:
[FI] A Denizen of Darkness such as myself, having 
transmigrated into a new vessel for the third time, 
witnessed the passing of untold time.

[FI] Bearing the "Queen", "Knight" and the "Black 
Beast" within, I have yet again, been carrying on an 
ordinary life as a "Human".

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT:
[FI] ...-chan. You're so absorbed in that, what are you 
writing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Fu... Have you forgotten, Aunt?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] My true name is †The Fallen Angel of the Chiba† 
Kuroneko. Make no mistake about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: [FI] ...Urgh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] ...Oh dear. Even though it's the true name inherited 
from none other than my aunt, what has happened?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Right? Aunt Tamaki. No... the last generation's 
Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT:
[FI] I-I beg of you, please stop calling me "the last 
generation".

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] I am already over that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] My pitiful Aunt. You have lost your magical powers, 
haven't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] ...Yes, I guess you can say that.

[FI] The pale-faced girl making a stiff smile is Gokou 
Tamaki.
[FI] She is, in every sense of the word, my foster parent.
[FI] She is my mentor in magic, and also my former self.
[FI] ...The "Kuroneko" from a generation ago.

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] Rino-chan, so... What are you writing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Did I not say, it's Kuroneko?

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] Then, Kuroneko-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Very well. I am not writing, but reading what my 
original self has written.

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] Ah... that is... so nostalgic.

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] Is that the... "Destiny Record"?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Indeed.

[FI] What I am reading once more is the "Destiny 
Record: Volume - Future World".

[FI] The book of destiny my former self has written for 
the coming world.

[FI] It's written of a certain ritual necessary to bind with 
the person you love, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You did not follow this fate, my Aunt.

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT:
[FI] ...Well, um... The wish of the person who wrote that 
has already been fulfilled.

[FI] A noisy voice suddenly cut itself into the 
conversation.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Kiri-nee~~, what's up with these jeans?! I can't 
possibly wear these~

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Eh? For real? Haven't you put too much weight on 
your legs, Hina-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] Y-You said it! The words that should not be uttered!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Sorry sorry, but can't you just go on a diet?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] I'm not at that level yet! Look at this 
despair-inducing tightness! The leg part is also too 
short!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, you're right. You'd better get a new one 
already.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Damn it~~! I should never have borrowed clothes 
from an active model!!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] W-What should I do with this overwhelming sense 
of defeat!!

[FI] These noisy middle-aged women are Kousaka 
Kirino and Gokou Hinata.
[FI] They are unusually close, often going out together.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Back to our conversation, Aunt Tamaki.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] "He" was bonded with "Her..." However, that is not 
the case according to my interpretation.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] After all, "her" soul is currently residing in this body.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Kukuku... I will follow in accordance with this book 
and pledge a vow with my beloved person.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] Rino-tan, Rino-tan, does that mean... "I'm marrying my 
Daddy!" or something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] D-Don't mistake this for such childish desires.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Don't marry that old man, marry me instead~~①

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] W-Wait... don't cling to me...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Fuhihi, you are too cute...! Rino-tan① Rino-tan①

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Uuuuu...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, don't make her cry.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] ...What are you all doing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Waaahhh-----, Kyousukeee----

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] There there, that old lady is scary, isn't she?
[FI] He kindly petted my head.
[FI] That warmth had always left me in a trance.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] W-Who are you calling an old lady!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hey, Kyousuke. The ritual... kiss me, please.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] ...Please don't say such foolish things, Rino.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] This man is my property.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're being immature again.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] Be quiet, please.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
[FI] ...I've been listening from the start, but 
"transmigration"?

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT:
[FI] I'm still alive, so how can my soul dwell in your 
body?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Hmph... That much is certain, original Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] But, the soul of an Exalted Fallen Angel has already 
transmigrated into this young body.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] And that body, worn of age, is already nothing 
more but an empty vessel.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=28]I-iiiii![/font_size]

[FI] I let out a scream after being pinched on the 
cheek.
[FI] This body is weak to pain.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] Good grief... I wonder who she takes it from.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No doubt it's you.

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] ...Really, I wonder how she turned out this way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's definitely from your negative influence.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Anyway, as far as I'm concerned, I'm happy my 
daughter likes me.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] Oh, is that so? In that case, I will make this clear.

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] Rino, watch this.

SPEAKER: SPK_ALL_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]Aaaaaaaaa![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_RURI
TEXT: [FI] Fufu... Well?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] U, uuuu...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Ku, kukuku...kukuku...
[FI] ...I won't forgive you.

[FI] I won't forgive you, won't forgive you, won't forgive 
you, WON'T FORGIVE YOU, WON'T FORGIVE YOU!
[FI] ...Negative thoughts, gathering to my body...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] H-Hey... Rino?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...No, I am Rino no longer.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I'm now-

SPEAKER: SPK_YAMINEKO
TEXT: [FI] --The Angel of Vengeance "Yamineko"!
[FI] The soul transcends to the next era.
[FI] History repeats itself.
